title: Muscat Tech Week
seoTitle: Muscat Tech Week — Event Identity | Lōn Visuals
lede: An identity for Muscat Tech Week that draws its soul from Oman’s evening skies, pairing the warmth of an Omani sunset with the energy of a region rising in technology.

blocks.label: Overview
blocks.title: The world is coming to Oman
paras: Muscat Tech Week gathers the region’s technology community in Oman’s capital. Its identity had to feel global enough for an international stage and unmistakably Omani at the same time.
The answer was found in the city itself: a compact monogram shaped by Omani heritage, and a colour system drawn from the sky over Muscat at dusk.

blocks.caption: Campaign line · The World Is Coming To Oman!

blocks.label: The Mark
blocks.title: A monogram with Omani roots
paras: The mtw monogram is built on a strict grid of verticals and arcs. Its signature detail, the small notch that curls from the shoulder of the m and the foot of the t, is drawn from the curve of the khanjar, the dagger at the heart of Oman’s emblem.
It is a quiet reference, felt more than seen, that gives a technology brand a sense of place.

blocks.label: Color Concept
blocks.title: Inspired by Oman’s magical sunsets
paras: The visual identity of Muscat Tech Week draws its soul from the breathtaking magic of Oman’s evening skies. The gradient palette is inspired by the natural harmony of sunset in Muscat, where deep indigo transitions into violet, then soft amber and golden hues melt into the cityscape.

This carefully designed colour system reflects both modern innovation and cultural depth. It captures the warmth of Omani hospitality, the richness of its heritage, and the rising energy of its future in technology. The palette works seamlessly across digital and physical mediums, on screens, stages, signage and merchandise, while remaining rooted in a sense of place.
This sunset isn’t just a view. It’s a symbol of transition, of energy, and of the promise that every new idea brings a new dawn.
